name: Western House B&B
accommodation: Four en-suite bedrooms, two with sea views
suitableFor: Couples and small groups wanting a B&B with breakfast
beachAccess: A short distance from Llangennith beach, within walking distance

overview: Western House is a small B&B in Llangennith with four en-suite rooms, two of them looking out to sea. It is within walking distance of the beach and the village pub, and has off-street parking in the yard and a deck with a barbecue.
surfTripFit: It's a short walk to Llangennith beach, with off-road parking and a cooked breakfast before an early surf.
